thread:
alex: Tiny travel thread for SF offsite logistics — two quick things: shuttle time + snack allergies. Promise short.
alex: Shuttle choices: 7:20am (gets you there by 8:35) or 8:40am (arrive ~9:55). Reply with '7' or '8'.
sara: 8 please, need the extra sleep :coffee:
mike: 7 for me, back-to-back afternoon calls.
jen: 8 and I'm volunteering to bring snacks. any requests?
tom: Nut allergy here — anything nut-free would be amazing. Also prefer vegan if easy.
alex: Got it, nut-free + vegan option. @jen you a hero.
jen: happy to! can bring energy bars and fruit. any bar recs?
sara: cliff or larabar (but larabar has nuts usually) so maybe clif or rxbar? rxbar has nuts tho. clif sounds safe.
mike: oat bars are good too. also will bring extra chargers/power strip if people want to borrow.
calendar-bot: Shuttle details updated: https://calendar.redwood.example/offsite-shuttle 
calendar-bot:
```
7:20am - Hotel Lobby (Union St)
8:40am - Hotel Lobby (Embarcadero)
Return shuttle: 5:45pm - Event Entrance
```
alex: Quick luggage poll for going home — reply 'carry' or 'check'.
jen: carry
tom: check (sweatshirts + stickers incoming)
sara: carry, only a backpack
mike: carry
alex: also pro tip: bring a small reusable tote for swag, hotel coffee opens early, and don't forget adaptors if you're traveling from out of country.
jen: meme https://imgur.example/packing-spiral.jpg :joy:
mike: brief PSA: if you need quiet room, DM me and I'll swap — I snore but bring earplugs.
alex: Thanks everyone — i'll message ops for nut-free vegan snack box and lock shuttle at noon. Ping me for swaps.
